issue_context.title: ComEd doesn't provide currency
issue_context.body:
### The problem

When adding a new device to energy dashboard and selecting the current-hour-average rate, I get the following error in the electricity grid box: 

Unexpected unit of measurement
Translation Error: The intl string context variable "currency" was not provided to the string "The following entities do not have the expected units of measurement ''{currency}/kWh'', ''{currency}/Wh'' or ''{currency}/MWh'':"
sensor.comed_current_hour_average_price (c)

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

Home Assistant 2022.7.2

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

ComEd

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/comed_hourly_pricing/
